Kitchens

We specialize in Cabinet Refacing or as we call it, Cabinet Restyling. The objective of cabinet restyling is to make your cabinets look brand new again, without tearing out your existing cabinets or countertop.

This will SAVE YOU up to 50% versus replacing with new cabinets and a lot more than that since you don’t have to replace the countertop or sink. In short, a new surface is put on the outside of your cabinets in the color of your choice.

Yes, you can completely change the color and style of your cabinets. New doors and new hardware are also installed. This is not paint! It is durable and lasts a long time.

Baths

First, we offer acrylic shower pans, tubs, and wall surrounds for a durable, long-lasting bathtub and/or shower for you to enjoy for many years to come. Acrylic showers also SAVE YOU up to 40% versus typical products.

There are several contractors offering acrylic systems and there are some minor differences. But here is one Major Difference between Newberry Home and other contractors. How many times have you heard a bath can be installed in 1 Day? Newberry Home Doesn’t want to be in a hurry during the installation.

Our employee installers and plumbers want to make sure the water is tested overnight, don’t you? This is why we take our time, do it right, and install your new bathtub or shower in 2 days.

A Product Warranty Is Only As Good As The Labor Warranty

We have all heard stories like this many times. The contractor did the work, and the homeowner finds a manufacturing defect in a product. Neither the company nor the contractor saw it during the installation process. In most cases, the manufacturer wants to receive the defective product before replacing it. The replacement is sent back to the contractor, who then presents the homeowner with a bill for their time. Wow!

Our suppliers have the same philosophy as we do when it comes to mistakes. They are going to happen every now and then. But it is how they are handled that makes all the difference. Our suppliers trust us to determine if there is a defect and will replace the material prior to us taking anything out. Kitchen Restylers matches the manufacturer’s warranty with a full labor warranty to cover any expenses associated with a defective product. That’s Peace of Mind!

What Is A Tub To Shower Conversion?

A tub to shower conversion is when we transform your outdated bathtub into a sleek, modern acrylic shower, enhancing both aesthetics and functionality.

Acrylic showers are a top choice for conversions due to their durability, easy maintenance, and sleek appearance.

Our team ensures a seamless installation process, providing you with a beautiful, custom-fit shower that perfectly suits your space.

Our Acrylic Showers

An acrylic shower offers several advantages over a traditional bathtub. Firstly, acrylic is a highly durable material that resists cracking, chipping, and fading, ensuring long-lasting beauty and functionality.

Its non-porous surface is easy to clean and maintain, preventing mold and mildew growth and saving you time on upkeep. Acrylic showers also provide improved accessibility, making them ideal for individuals with mobility issues.

Additionally, they can be customized with various styles and features to suit any bathroom design, offering a modern and space-efficient upgrade over a bathtub.

What is Cabinet Restyling?

The front and sides of a cabinet are called the face of the cabinet. The term refacing is used to describe the process of applying a new veneer over the front and sides of the cabinets. Changing out the doors and drawer fronts along with crown, shoe molding and other trim pieces can be added to complete the look.

What Is Cabinet Refacing & Cabinet Resurfacing?

A Product Warranty Is Only As Good As The Labor Warranty

We have all heard stories like this many times. The contractor did the work and the homeowner finds a manufacturing defect in a product. Neither the company nor the contractor saw it during the installation process. In most cases, the manufacturer wants to receive the defective product before replacing it. The replacement is sent back to the contractor, who then presents the homeowner with a bill for their time. Wow!

Our suppliers have the same philosophy as we do when it comes to mistakes. They are going to happen every now and then. But it is how they are handled that makes all the difference. Our suppliers trust us to determine if there is a defect and will replace the material prior to us taking anything out. Kitchen Restylers matches the manufacturers warranty with a full labor warranty to cover any expenses associated with a defective product. That’s Peace of Mind!
